generate_pointmap_target: generate a 3D pointmap from depth, mask, and camera intrinsic matrix K
pack_pointmap_inputs: pack images and pointmap targets into SegDataSample for model input
random_pointmap_crop: randomly crop images, depth maps, and masks while adjusting camera intrinsics
pointmap_resize: resize images, masks, and depth maps to a fixed target size with intrinsics adjustment
pad_pointmap: pad images and segmentation maps to a fixed size or size divisor
